parameters.name: ResourceIds
parameters.description: The resource IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). You can specify a maximum of 20 IDs at a time.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The resource type. Valid values:
- **video**: video.
- **image**: image.
- **attached**: auxiliary media asset.

parameters.name: TargetAppId
parameters.description: The ID of the destination application. Default value: **app-1000000**. For more information, see [Multi-application](~~113600~~).
